context: A mom and son chat about an outdoor day
purpose: Teach: とおし/うける/ぐち/たいそう/囲い/甘かっ/質素/ガバ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、運動会、ぶっとおしで、走るのかな、僕。
lines.en: Mom, do I have to run the whole way through at the sports day?
lines.style: Tentative, genuinely curious. Soft opening. Slight upswing on the question, seeking reassurance rather than information. A small worry he's been holding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。ピエロさんの芸、子供たちにうけるね。
lines.en: Yeah. The clown act really made all the kids laugh.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, slightly distracted. Responding to his question but also thinking about something else—the festival. Easy, maternal tone without forced enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃんが、いつもぐち言ってるよ、宿題のこと。
lines.en: My brother's always complaining about homework.
lines.style: Observant, matter-of-fact delivery. Not tattling—noticing. Small, genuine laugh underneath. A kid reporting what he's noticed about the world around him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祭りの飾り、たいそう立派ね、今年は。
lines.en: The festival decorations are really impressive this year, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle redirect, noticing his mind wandering. Warm but purposeful—drawing him toward something pleasant. Light touch of affection without calling attention to the shift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の囲い、いつ、新しくしたんだろう?
lines.en: I wonder when they fixed the fence at the park?
lines.style: Soft wondering aloud. Distracted, drifting between observations. No expectation of an answer—just thinking out loud in the way children do when comfortable. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祭りの飴、すごく甘かったね、翔くん。
lines.en: The festival candy was really sweet, wasn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Warm recollection, turning back to him. Slight conspiratorial tone—acknowledging a shared memory. Not questioning, affirming. The tenderness of remembering something he enjoyed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの部屋、質素で、いつも綺麗だね。
lines.en: Grandma's room is so simple and neat, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, observational appreciation. Gentle wonder at the tidiness and restraint. No judgment—admiration. Quiet respect woven through the words. A child noticing something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 寝坊して、ガバッと布団から、飛び起きたわね、翔くん。
lines.en: You certainly bolted upright out of that futon when you overslept, didn't you?
lines.style: Wry, affectionate amusement. Slight laugh in the voice. Warm teasing about a familiar moment. Not scolding—remembering with gentle humor. The fondness of a parent recalling a small, authentic thing her child did.
